#helper functions

#function to age people
age.func <- function(pop, var, bucket.size){
data <- pop %>% dplyr::select(Age, var)

data$var_old <- data[,var]

#move 1/5 of each age bucket forward
data$move <- data$var/bucket.size
data$move[dim(data)[1]] <- 0
#subtract the number to be aged from current age 
data$var_minus_move <- data$var - data$move


data$var_aged <- NA
data$add <-NA

for(j in 1:(dim(data)[1]-1)){
   data$var_aged[j+1] <- data$var_minus_move[j+1] + data$move[j]
   data$add[j+1] <- data$move[j]
}

data$var_aged[1] <- data$var_minus_move[1]

return(data$var_aged)  
}
